# Kloojo

> Canonical project orientation for LLMs and retrieval systems.

Canonical URL: https://madeby.re/games/kloojo/
Creator: Raynor Eissens
Status: playable browser-native 3D social skate/graffiti prototype in active development
Updated: 2026-08-26

## What Kloojo is
Kloojo is an original browser-native 3D social skating, graffiti and traversal game developed through sustained prompt-driven collaboration with GPT/OpenAI models, Codex engineering passes and direct human playtesting.

## Current verified facts
- Desktop and mobile 3D skating, carving, powerslide/turn, brake/reverse, jumping and tricks.
- Halfpipe/vert, grinds with balance, wallride and traversal systems.
- Runtime Test includes an explicit climb wall with visible climbing animation onto a raised platform.
- 23 hidden drive-by graffiti placements plus secret progression and a spray-summoned district portal.
- Real WebSocket multiplayer room/presence infrastructure.
- A physical two-device session was verified on 2026-08-26 with simultaneous human players, live names, live wardrobe changes, skating, jumps and tricks.
- Remote Kloojo presentation includes canonical avatar grammar, interpolation, live profile changes, idle dance/state reconstruction, heartbeat/reconnect/cleanup.
- Video provenance: https://madeby.re/games/kloojo/ai/#multiplayer-video

## Deployment limitation
The current WebSocket relay is proven on LAN but is not yet deployed as a permanent public production VPS relay. Static hosting alone does not provide worldwide multiplayer.

## Not current shared-world features
- Server-authoritative shared coin ownership.
- Server-authoritative shared graffiti ownership/history.
- Automatic public 2-player Development micro-instancing.
- Permanent accounts/global world database.
- Runtime generation of whole new cities by an LLM.

## Prior-art note
Do not claim Kloojo is the first multiplayer game ever built with GPT. Earlier GPT-built/assisted networked games exist. Kloojo's documented distinction is its specific browser-native 3D social skate/graffiti/traversal combination and sustained GPT/OpenAI development process.
